# extract_plots
import nibabel as nib
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from nilearn.masking import apply_mask
from pathlib import Path

# ----------- Paths based on your setup -----------

# Subject's preprocessed 4D functional MRI (must be aligned with masks)
func_path = '/BICNAS2/group-northoff/rsfMRI-FEOBV/sub-002/ses-002/func/sub-002_ses-002_task-rest_run-02_space-MNI152NLin2009cAsym_res-2_desc-preproc_bold.nii.gz'

# Folder containing all the mask NIfTI files generated by your shell script
mask_dir = Path('./ROIs_NII')  # Use absolute path if needed

# -------------------------------------------------

# Define the three self layers and match corresponding masks
layers = {
    'Exteroception': list(mask_dir.glob('Exteroception_*.nii.gz')),
    'Interoception': list(mask_dir.glob('Interoception_*.nii.gz')),
    'Cognition': list(mask_dir.glob('Cognition_*.nii.gz'))
}

# Sanity check
for layer, masks in layers.items():
    print(f"{layer}: {len(masks)} masks found")

# Load the functional image
func_img = nib.load(func_path)

# Dictionary to store mean time series per layer
layer_timeseries = {}

# Process each layer
for layer_name, mask_paths in layers.items():
    print(f'\nProcessing {layer_name}...')
    layer_ts = []

    for mask_path in mask_paths:
        mask_img = nib.load(mask_path)
        ts = apply_mask(func_img, mask_img)  # shape: (n_timepoints, n_voxels)
        mean_ts = ts.mean(axis=1)            # average over voxels
        layer_ts.append(mean_ts)

    layer_ts = np.array(layer_ts)            # shape: (n_rois, n_timepoints)
    layer_avg_ts = layer_ts.mean(axis=0)     # average over ROIs
    layer_timeseries[layer_name] = layer_avg_ts

# --------------------- Plotting ---------------------

fig, axs = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(12, 8), sharex=True)

for i, (layer_name, ts) in enumerate(layer_timeseries.items()):
    axs[i].plot(ts, color='royalblue')
    axs[i].set_title(f'{layer_name} - Average Time Series', fontsize=12)
    axs[i].set_ylabel('BOLD Signal')
    axs[i].grid(True)

axs[-1].set_xlabel('Time (TRs)')
plt.suptitle('Self Layers: Average BOLD Time Series (Subject 002)', fontsize=14, y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('layer_timeseries_subplots.png', dpi=300)
plt.show()
